title: 3_8_Howards_Holidays

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Would you want to be friends with Paige?
options: Only if we got to go on fancy trips!

question_options.question: Have you ever kissed someone on New Year's Eve?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Happy new year.
An hour later, Howard heads home... And finds the twins waiting for him!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: How was your fancy party?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah! What are you two doing in here?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You wouldn't let us go to the party!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So we at least want to hear about it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was good. I saw a lot of old friends... Played some video games... Really, twins, being 'grown up' isn't as exciting as you think it is.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Was $ZOE at the party?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It still makes you sad to think about her, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In a way. I'll always care about her. But I guess right now, our lives are just in different places.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When I tried to hold on to her, I only ended up holding her back. And if I keep holding on to her memory now, I'm just going to make myself miserable.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess what I'm saying is, sometimes you might not be exactly where you `want` to be, but you just have to make the best of it and try to enjoy where you are.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess what I'm saying is, sometimes you might not be exactly where you [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to be, but you just have to make the best of it and try to enjoy where you are.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like you two. Don't be in `too` much of a rush to grow up. Once you're grown up, you can't exactly go back.
nodes.text_bbcode: Like you two. Don't be in [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] much of a rush to grow up. Once you're grown up, you can't exactly go back.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I guess... That's a good point.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah... Thanks, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now get some rest. And do me a favor and don't start dating boys for at least fifteen years.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No promises.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But we'll take it into consideration.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Deal.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good night, girls.
Howard's holiday break is drawing to a close... But at least he got some quality time with his family and maybe even learned a little more about himself!

Howard and Elliana share a brief New Year's kiss!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Happy new year, Howard! I hope this year will be a good one for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Elliana.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I understand. But Howard, remember... You're in college now. And you're single.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: The rules are a little different.
Elliana pecks Howard on his cheek.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Happy new year, Howard. Here's to a new year for you. I hope it finds you well.
Howard freezes. Elliana kisses him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Did you not want...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just... It's...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Howard, you don't have to feel guilty.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Happy new year, Howard. Here's to a new year for you. I hope it finds you well.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You'll always be an important person to me... And I know the holidays aren't the easiest for you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I always think my parents might come visit, but I guess I just can't compete with Christmas in Paris...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Believe me, if my parents were in Paris, you wouldn't be able to drag them back here in handcuffs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And anyway, it's just nice to see you! I know the twins will be happy you're here.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay!
The twins mob $ZOE with a hug!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We've missed you!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, girls... I've missed you too! Here, I brought you cookies!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Sweet! Your cookies are the best.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe you can teach us how to bake them sometime!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The last time I tried to teach you two how to bake, you put hot sauce in the frosting...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Please, that was a `long` time ago.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, that was a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] time ago.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, didn't you know? We're all grown up now.
Howard ruffles Kay and Kel's hair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'All grown up' is relative.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Don't mess up our hair!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, things really `are` changing around here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, things really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] changing around here.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE! Did I hear you brought cookies?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep! My famous heart-shaped gingerbread cookies frosted with strawberry icing!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Out of the way, twins. I'll take those cookies. Er. Down to the den. And set them out for everyone...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Just don't eat them all, darling.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, why don't you come down and chat for a bit? I'll make us all some tea!
And so, Howard and his family spend the next few hours with $ZOE...
Sharing stories...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then Paige was running against me for the position of Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I had to set up this spooky haunted house. Can you imagine anyone worse to plan something creepy and scary?
...Catching up on gossip...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And then Chip told Kay that he was in love with her, but he thought she was `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And then Chip told Kay that he was in love with her, but he thought she was [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: How can he think he's in love with one of us when he can't even tell us apart?!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Who's this Chip guy? I don't want you anywhere near him! Why haven't you told me about him before?
And remembering old times...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe I just went to France to find you. I don't even know French!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, it was sweet. Crazy, but sweet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I guess it's about time for me to get going. Thank you so much for having me over.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're welcome here any time, sweetheart.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We'll walk you out to your car!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, we have more gossip that we can't tell you about around the parents.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What?!
As the twins walk $ZOE to the door, Cathy puts a hand on Howard's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That seemed like it went well.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... It was good to see her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Seeing $ZOE just stirs up a lot of memories, I guess. I've been trying so hard to get her out of my head, and now...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Maybe you should get out of the house more while you're back here.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You've got other friends in town, don't you? Maybe you should see them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR did invite me to a party...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You two were so close your sophomore year! You should go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah, maybe I will...
And so, on New Year's Eve, Howard heads to the party...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Is that... Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Beth! Hey!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Howard. Good to see you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Adam?! You... Have changed.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Adam and I are part of Centerscore U's `Dark and Stormy Night Slam Poetry` club.
nodes.text_bbcode: Adam and I are part of Centerscore U's [color=#3b78e2][i]Dark and Stormy Night Slam Poetry[/i][/color] club.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow. Do you still play football?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I'm kind of over the whole football thing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me too, actually.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No way! Did I just hear you gave up on the game?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I wouldn't have believed it. Howard, you were one of the best wide receivers I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Chuck! Hey! Yeah, I haven't played in... Well, a long time.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I say we throw down right here, right now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can't really be suggesting that we play football right now...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Heh, not a `real` game.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh, not a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] game.

nodes.text: Bryce points to a couple of people across the room playing a football video game.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: And I say we're up next. Come on, Chuck will give you a quick explanation about how to play, and then it's game time!
Bryce pulls Howard down into a chair and a crowd starts to gather to watch...
Howard opens his arms and gives $ZOE a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's good to see you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, for a second there I was worried this would be awkward.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awkward? Between us? Never!
Howard reaches out to shake $ZOE's hand as $ZOE reaches out to hug Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I guess this is a little awkward... Maybe I shouldn't have come.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way! I'm glad you stopped by.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...
And so, a few minutes later, Howard and the twins emerge from the store. The twins grin as they hold their shopping bags.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, this was a great Christmas present!
As Howard and the twins head back to the car, Howard spots a pair of college students and stops...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... I know that guy! $USR!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Hey! Is that... Howard?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR! Hey! Or, I guess they're calling you 'Flash' these days, huh?

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Heh, that's right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you'll always be $USR to me.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Fair enough. Bryce, you remember Howard!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Of course! This guy! It's good to see you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's great to see guys. It's been way too long.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Totally. Every time you're home, you always spend all your time hanging out with the high school kids.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well, not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You guys remember $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That's right, she's the high school girl that you're all serious about.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, we broke up.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that, man.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Break ups suck. No way around that.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: But there `are` ways to make them suck less. Come out with us for New Year's Eve! We're having a big party at the frat.
nodes.text_bbcode: But there [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] ways to make them suck less. Come out with us for New Year's Eve! We're having a big party at the frat.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Yeah, you should come! There's going to be a lot of familiar faces from high school there.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, it's not like Howard's got any other plans.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Sorry... I know it's not nice...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But it `is` true.
nodes.text_bbcode: But it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] true.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Heh, even your little sisters are calling you out.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey! We're not so little!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honestly, it `is` weird being back in town and not seeing $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: Honestly, it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] weird being back in town and not seeing $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: So you'll come to the party?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I don't know. I haven't exactly been in the mood for a party lately.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: What? That sounds crazy. You need to snap out of it. Just come. It'll be fun.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Can we come too?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! It sounds like fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! No way! You two are still `way` too young for a college party.
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding?! No way! You two are still [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too young for a college party.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Ugh, older brothers are such a downer.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Sorry, girls, but he's right. Give it a few more years.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or ten. Or fifteen. There's really no rush.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Anyway, come to the party, Howard! Merry Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You too! And thanks for the invite. I'll think about it.
The next day, it's Christmas morning! Howard and his family all sit around the Christmas tree opening presents.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: A new laptop! Horace, this is too much.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Nonsense.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard, you got `two` stuffed unicorns and a rattle for baby Kara? That's adorable!
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard, you got [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] stuffed unicorns and a rattle for baby Kara? That's adorable!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Goo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aww... She does seem happy.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Eeek! OMG!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Earrings! Really?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Yes, girls. Your father and I talked it over, and we decided that you're old enough.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This is the best Christmas ever!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I got... More canned soup. Mom, you know they feed us at college, right?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What if the dining hall is closed? What if you get sick? You can never have too much soup!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Listen to your mother. What kind of man complains about having too much soup?
Just then, the doorbell rings...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who could that be? We're all here... Who else would come on Christmas morning?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh... Howard... I meant to tell you, but it never seemed like a good time to bring it up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE emailed me yesterday and asked if she could stop by... I hope you don't mind, sweetheart.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?! $ZOE's here?! Right now?!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I just couldn't say no... You know how hard it is for her with her parents off in Europe.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you didn't want to warn me?!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I thought it would be better this way... No time to agonize over it. Now, go get the door before she thinks we're not home.
Howard heads over to the door...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, Howard. You can do this. Just open the door. This is totally normal. Just your ex-girlfriend visiting your family.
Howard opens the door and finds $ZOE smiling awkwardly at him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! It's $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'It's $ZOE'? What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! You look great! I mean, I missed you! Er, I mean, it's really good to see you!
$ZOE steps forward to greet Howard...
Howard and the twins walk into the makeup store...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hello, can I help you? Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh, Howard?! Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! Hey, Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: OMG. I didn't know you were back in town!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, back for the holidays!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... What exactly brings you to `Pro Makeup Style?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So... What exactly brings you to [color=#3b78e2][i]Pro Makeup Style?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's my little sisters. They want to buy some makeup.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: They grow up so fast, don't they? I see they've found our `deluxe` line...
nodes.text_bbcode: They grow up so fast, don't they? I see they've found our [color=#3b78e2][i]deluxe[/i][/color] line...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oooh, look at this bright green eyeshadow!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I like this lipstick!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second, did you say this was the deluxe line?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's right! Normally, lipstick and eyeshadow start around twenty dollars, but these...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, let's just say they're a little more.
Howard looks at the price tag, and his jaw drops.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls, isn't there, um, anything else you'd like to look at?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No, this is what we want! You said you'd get us anything!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, no going back on your promises, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, all right. But don't expect any birthday presents after this.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You always forget to buy us birthday presents anyway!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Heh. Sorry, Howard. It looks like they've got you there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Cute boots... Strappy sandals... This is so grown up!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You know, it sounds a lot less grown up when you call it grown up.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Oh, yeah. Right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You guys don't need to be in `too` much of a rush to grow up.
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys don't need to be in [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] much of a rush to grow up.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hah. Adults always say that. Kel, look at these ballet flats!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So cute!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great! Let's get them!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... `Lots` of shoes are cute. But that doesn't mean we know what we want yet.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, Howard... [color=#3b78e2][i]Lots[/i][/color] of shoes are cute. But that doesn't mean we know what we want yet.

nodes.text: And so, an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, I think we've got the boots that we want!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Finally!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, you'll like this part... These shoes are on sale.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hmph. You got lucky.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... I know it's been really tough... You and $ZOE were so close, it's natural for it to take a while for you to get over all that happened.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, please. Howard's not even `trying` to get over her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, please. Howard's not even [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] to get over her.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Seriously. All he's done since he's been home is mope and mope.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Girls, be nice to your brother. You don't know what he's going through.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now, Cathy, the girls have a point. Howard should be getting out of the house, having some fun, breaking a few laws...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Not `big` laws. Just getting into a little trouble! It's what kids do! Here, son... Take my car today.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#e23b3b][i]big[/i][/color] laws. Just getting into a little trouble! It's what kids do! Here, son... Take my car today.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Go to the mall, or a bowling alley, or a chat room. Wherever kids your age go these days.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I can go to the mall... But you know a chat room isn't actually a room, right?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: A chat room's not a room? What is `wrong` with this generation? Back in my day, you didn't call it a room unless it had four walls and a ceiling!
nodes.text_bbcode: A chat room's not a room? What is [color=#e23b3b][i]wrong[/i][/color] with this generation? Back in my day, you didn't call it a room unless it had four walls and a ceiling!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: If Howard's going to the mall, can we go with him?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, can we?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That would actually give me some time to finish wrapping presents... Howard, would you mind?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, they can come.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Aw, how sweet! My kids, all going to the mall together. Have fun, and don't be out too late!
And so, twenty minutes later, Howard and the twins are at the mall...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't get it, twins. I've been back for almost a whole week, and you two haven't tried to pull a single prank on me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No wild animals in my bed, no hot sauce on my food... Not even a single leaf of poison ivy in my sock drawer.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just tell me now, are you planning something truly horrible?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know Mom and Dad said you'd be sent to military school if you do anything involving fire and gasoline again.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Please, Howard, we're `so` over pranks.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, Howard, we're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] over pranks.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah. We're not `children` anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. We're not [color=#3b78e2][i]children[/i][/color] anymore.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you talking about?! Of course you are!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No way! Have you seen Kara? `She's` a child.
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! Have you seen Kara? [color=#3b78e2][i]She's[/i][/color] a child.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, have you not been paying attention? We're `thirteen.` As in, `teenagers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, have you not been paying attention? We're [color=#3b78e2][i]thirteen.[/i][/color] As in, [color=#3b78e2][i]teenagers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And pranks are kids' stuff. We're like, totally done with pranks.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now, we like shopping!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And gossip!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And reality tv!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess a lot `has` changed while I've been gone.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess a lot [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] changed while I've been gone.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You'd know that if you ever spent any time with us. We're not kids anymore.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that probably means you're not going to like the stuffed unicorns I got you for Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, come on! We never would have liked those!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, twins. Look, how about I make it up to you right now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll take you shopping as your Christmas present, and you can pick out whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That's... Kind of awesome, Howard. Thanks! I don't even know where to start...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let's go to `Pro Makeup Style!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's go to [color=#3b78e2][i]Pro Makeup Style![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No, let's go to `Shoes, Shoes, Shoes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, let's go to [color=#3b78e2][i]Shoes, Shoes, Shoes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard, tie-breaking vote?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, the twins really have grown up... I never thought they'd disagree about anything!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or that they'd actually ask me for advice!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So, which store?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE and I broke up, but that doesn't take away what we had...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even if it's kind of depressing to remember it now, I don't want to pretend like it never happened.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's a very mature perspective, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Too bad it doesn't make it any easier.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. It just doesn't mean the same thing anymore.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Here, I'll get rid of that for you.
Kay grabs the ornament and throws it in the trash.
Howard winces as the glass shatters and is suddenly filled with regret.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The duck! What have you done?! Can we still put it back together?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Uh, calm down, it's just an ornament.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This ornament is like my relationship with $ZOE! It's broken now, but maybe we can put it back together! Maybe...
Howard's mom pulls him away from the trash.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's obviously upsetting you to see it.

nodes.text: Paige has no choice... She brings up her hand, slowly painting a perfect pair of smiling lips on the doll.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Perfect! You know, she looks just like you!
Paige stares down at the doll's vacant eyes and painted smile.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's wrong, Paige? You look sad!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sad. I'm... I'm angry! I don't know what your plan is, but I refuse to let it go on any longer!
Paige shoves back the table and jumps up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wouldn't do that if I were you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Be careful!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm done listening to you. Any of you!
Taylor snaps her fingers, and there's a sparkle of magic around Paige as Taylor tries to hold her still.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Resist Santa Taylor's magic!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can't control me!
Paige suddenly feels a jolt run all through her body!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, this is going to be trouble.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm afraid you're right, Paige. You don't belong here. You're not an elf at all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you don't belong with Prissy and the other good boys and girls...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sad to say that you don't belong anywhere!
Another jolt shoots through Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's happening to me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No!
Paige loses focus, and Taylor's magic grips her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nnnuuhhh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm afraid you're right, Paige. You don't belong here. You're not an elf at all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you don't belong with Prissy and the other good boys and girls...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sad to say that you don't belong anywhere!
Taylor waves her hand, and Paige feels darkness creeping in around her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where are you sending me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Everything in its place, dear. I don't know where you're going, but wherever it is... It's where you belong.
Darkness closes in all around Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello? Is anyone here?
Paige can't hear anything, feel anything, taste anything, or see anything, and is starting to get really creeped out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Elf girls! Are you here? I'd even tolerate seeing you right now. Crazy power-hungry Santa Taylor? Helloooo?
There's no answer, and the silence stretches on...
...And on...
...And on...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sniff... Wait... Is that... Caviar? And popcorn shrimp? Lobster?
Suddenly, Paige's surroundings snap into place. She's in a fancy restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh? This is... That restaurant I went to with the girls last year... For New Year's Eve...
What starts as a distant murmur suddenly grows until all around her, Paige hears people talking and laughing!
Suddenly a countdown begins!
The voices begin counting down! 'Five... Four... Three...'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where is everyone? Hello?
Paige runs through the restaurant, but even though she hears people, no one is in sight!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Answer me! Where are you?
'Two... One!' The clock strikes midnight! The crowd cheers! People clink glasses and blow party favors!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where is everyone? Why am I all alone here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why is everyone in this stupid world always leaving me?
Paige slumps to the ground, her head in her hands.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Taylor said I belong here... That I don't belong with anyone. But...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want to be alone... Please... Don't leave me here...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There must be someone...
A beeping sound startles Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wha...?
She looks down and sees her phone buzzing. '1 New Text from Owen.'
Paige awakens with a start, her hand gripped tightly around her phone.
Paige looks down and sees that her phone still reads '1 New Text from Owen.'
Paige taps her phone and reads...
'Okay, rich girl. Don't tell me your fancy cell phone doesn't get reception up in your ivory tower.'
A small smile flits across Paige's face.
And she texts back.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'It's a ski lodge, not an ivory tower... But I hardly expect you to know the difference.'
Paige smiles and curls her hand over her phone, drifting back off to sleep.
Once again, the silence and darkness stretch on...
...And on...
...And on...
Paige can't hear anything, feel anything, taste anything, or see anything, and is starting to get really creeped out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great, I'm going to be stuck forever in some stupid limbo with an uninspired color scheme.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aaaah!
Paige's scream is echoed back at her, magnified a hundred fold!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that was unpleasant.
Paige rubs at her ears.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great, I'm going to be stuck forever in some stupid limbo with an uninspired color scheme.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great, I'm going to be stuck forever in some stupid limbo with an uninspired color scheme.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now, Paige... Do you remember the first time your parents sent you away?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My parents? What do they have to do with any of this?
Suddenly, the world shifts around Paige...
And she finds herself in a cold, dark building.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where am I? What is this place?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paige! There you are.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: $ZOE? What's going on here? Where are we? I want to go back to the lodge.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're both here, Paige, because we don't have parents. This is the Orphanage of Lost Souls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's no staff and no other children. We've been sent here because no one wants to be with us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And you're just okay with this? 'Cause your cheerfulness about this is really starting to freak me out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there's no point in putting on a sad face about it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, please! Don't play all sugar-gumdrops-and-rainbows with me. We're both in the same boat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Our parents don't want us. Just face up to it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, my. That's a `very` sad way of looking at things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, my. That's a [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] sad way of looking at things.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sad! I'm furious! And you should be too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just because our parents aren't with us during the holidays doesn't mean they don't care!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure they're thinking about us `right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure they're thinking about us [color=#3b78e2][i]right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, probably laughing it up about how much fun they're having now that they don't have us cluttering up their lives!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can see there's just no reasoning with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there's no more time for pouting! We've got work to do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: {{ There's work to do, oh work to do! Scrub the floor, then do another chore! {{

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: {{ Might as well smile! It's going to take a while! {{

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You are `actually` trying to drive me insane, aren't you? Your singing sounds like an accordion in a wood chipper!
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] trying to drive me insane, aren't you? Your singing sounds like an accordion in a wood chipper!

nodes.text: Suddenly, a little kitten slinks up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Meow? Meow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that, kitty? You want to help? Why, of course!

nodes.speaker: Unicorn
nodes.text: Neigh! Neigh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Mr. Unicorn, you want to help too? You're so kind!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You have `got` to be kidding me.
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#3b78e2][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding me.

nodes.text: Just then, the door to the orphanage is thrown open!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm here to save you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!
Owen rushes to $ZOE's side and lifts her high in the air in a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Dearest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My love!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, how could anyone resist your charms?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean her deliberate and unjustified enthusiasm? Or her misplaced and obnoxious optimism?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Her spirit. Her cheerfulness, even in the face of difficulties. How could anyone choose you over such a bright spot of sunshine?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not fair! $ZOE is always so `happy!` Why? Why should she always be making the best of everything? How can she be so happy when she has so little?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not fair! $ZOE is always so [color=#3b78e2][i]happy![/i][/color] Why? Why should she always be making the best of everything? How can she be so happy when she has so little?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, I think it's time we leave Paige to her fate.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. No!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't leave me! That's an order!
But Owen and $ZOE walk out the door with slow, deliberate steps, sparing only a single glance back at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel sorry for you, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aargh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that didn't seem to go very well...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You two. What are you doing back here?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Paige is `never` going to learn her lesson.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige is [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] going to learn her lesson.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're right, because there's `no lesson to learn!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right, because there's [color=#3b78e2][i]no lesson to learn![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just want to go home!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Paige... You don't have a home.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... But...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh oh... Do you hear that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Time's up.
Elf Sam and Elf Amanda freeze! Paige hears the sound of jingling sleigh bells, hooves on the rooftop, and then...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: HO HO HO!
Taylor comes crashing down through the chimney in a huge red sleigh pulled by eight flying reindeer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure. Why not a bunch of reindeer?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls! You said you were running out to the store for reindeer food!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We... Um...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. I knew Taylor was on a power trip from being school President, but this is new even for her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, there's no time for excuses, my little elves. We've got to go!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, Santa Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes, Santa Taylor.
Elf Sam and Elf Amanda climb into Santa Taylor's sleigh.
Santa Taylor looks at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come, come now. It's time for all good little elves to get back to the workshop!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Those toys aren't going to make themselves, you know.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not an elf! And I'm not coming with you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nonsense. You must be an elf. Why else would you be here with Elf Amanda and Elf Sam?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um, I don't know, because they abducted me to teach me some stupid Christmas lesson?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, hah hah! What an active imagination for an elf! Time to put it to work on toys! Bring her in!
Elf Sam and Elf Amanda grab Paige and haul her into the sled!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Get your hands off me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This won't hurt if you stop struggling.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, everyone in?
Santa Taylor snaps her fingers and the world blurs and shifts around Paige...
When everything settles, she's standing in a huge toy store!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My, my! We've got so much to do! The good little children that we're making toys for have already arrived!
Paige looks up and sees a raised seating area that overlooks the workshop. On it, she spots Prissy, Madisenn, and Penelope!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Does that girl down there look kind of like Paige?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige... Yes, I remember her! She wasn't very nice.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Please, girls, we don't need to concern ourselves with elves. `They` serve `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, girls, we don't need to concern ourselves with elves. [color=#3b78e2][i]They[/i][/color] serve [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ahem! Speaking of which, I need some more peppermint hot chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right away, Miss.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?! What's he doing here?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Faster, servant!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes, of course. I'm so very sorry, Miss.
Owen rushes to bring Prissy her drink.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Very good, servant. You may kiss my hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! Prissy, get away from him!
Paige runs up the staircase to the balcony and pushes Prissy away from Owen!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: How dare you! Do you even know who I am?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elf! This girl is at the top of the 'Nice' list! You have to treat her courteously!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, please. I don't know how things work around here, but I can just about guarantee you that Prissy belongs on the 'Naughty' list.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, sure, I `started` there... But I was able to pay some poor sap to take my place! And with the right 'donations'... I climbed up to the top of the 'Nice' list.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, sure, I [color=#3b78e2][i]started[/i][/color] there... But I was able to pay some poor sap to take my place! And with the right 'donations'... I climbed up to the top of the 'Nice' list.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you hearing this, Santa Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm afraid the list is the list... There's no second-guessing it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, if you won't do anything, I will!
Paige launches herself at Prissy, but Santa Taylor snaps her fingers, and Paige freezes in mid-air!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, dear... Looks like this little elf needs help getting to work!
Santa Taylor snaps her fingers again.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What...?
Paige finds herself forced to sit down on a workbench, her hands magically stretched out in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elf Sam! Elf Amanda! This little elf needs some help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll show her how to be one of us!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We'll show her what to do!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here, Paige. Start with this doll.
Paige looks down and sees a little princess doll appear in her hands.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Paint a smile on her face!
A paintbrush appears in Paige's hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: There's no need to be insulting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's every need!

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Such anger, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You haven't even begun to see angry.

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, would a closed-minded person even be talking to her `Pegasus?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, would a closed-minded person even be talking to her [color=#3b78e2][i]Pegasus?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: You are starting to understand.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You know what, just forget it. You've been gone too long, Paige. Things have changed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, Prissy's really trying to undermine me. I didn't realize she was just waiting for me to get out of the way so she could move in as queen bee.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forget gossip. This is boring. I want to go skiing.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Okay! Should we--

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wait! It's `so` cold outside. I think we should stay here and get another round of this amazing hot chocolate.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cold outside. I think we should stay here and get another round of this amazing hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But it's getting dark, sweetie. We can only ski for another hour before it's too late.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, but that just means it'll be a lot of work getting our ski gear on and then by that time, we'll only get a few minutes to ski!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, girls. We're going skiing!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Um... Er...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Seriously?! What's wrong with them? Are they actually going to question `me?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously?! What's wrong with them? Are they actually going to question [color=#3b78e2][i]me?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Waiter! More hot chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Fine. Let's just stay here.
Paige scowls while Penelope and Madisenn share an obviously relieved look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Looks like more's changed while I've been gone than I thought. Prissy's really trying to oust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And my other minions are just going to let it happen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh!
Paige looks down at her phone on the table and sees a text from Owen... Prissy leans over to look...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Owen? Please tell me it's not that guy from Twin Branches you were talking about. Wasn't he that $ZOE girl's lapdog?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um, yeah. He just, I guess he got my number when we did that psych project together.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And now he keeps texting you? What a stalker! But what can you expect from someone like him?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I mean, he literally lives on the wrong side of the tracks. You're not going to text him back, are you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course not! He's not even in my tax bracket!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wow, struck a nerve, huh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm just sick of him bothering me.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Let's do something fun! Hey, there's a group of cute guys over there! We could totally party with them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Must we?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Not all of us go to co-ed schools. Don't be so selfish!
Prissy stands and turns to one of the staff members of the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You! I want sparkling blood orange soda!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Miss, but we're about to close...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I'm sure you realize that the rules don't apply to us. Just ask your manager if you don't believe me. And bring me some warm chocolate chip cookies!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: But... We don't serve chocolate chip cookies...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, then, go out and get some! Now!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: And we need music!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, play something fun and dance-y!
One of the staff members hastily turns on a radio... Prissy jumps up on the couch and starts dancing!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Now `this` is a party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] is a party!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, please. This is just like every other year we've gone on a trip together.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Um, yeah, and it's fun.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Come on, Paige! Join us!
The boys near the fireplace stare at Prissy and the other girls. They start whispering to each other, then one of the boys waves for the girls to come over.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Pfft! Like `we'd` ever actually go over to--
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft! Like [color=#3b78e2][i]we'd[/i][/color] ever actually go over to--

nodes.text: Prissy, Madisenn, and Penelope all rush over toward the guys!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Girls! Girls, wait!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one's even listening to me.
Paige sneaks away from her friends and curls up in one of the chairs on the other side of the lobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Those girls used to follow whatever I said... They were practically afraid of me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And now just because I've been gone a few months, they're treating me like I'm a total stranger!
From there, she watches the other girls and takes out her phone to read Owen's text.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'So did you go with solid-gold skis or solid-diamond?'
Paige stares at the text, torn between replying and deleting it...
Paige is still staring at it as her eyelids start to feel heavy...
And everything goes dark.
When Paige opens her eyes, she's in the stables at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh? What... Happened? I must have been daydreaming...
Paige looks down and sees a brush in her hand. In front of her is her horse, William!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello, boy! I bet you want your coat brushed, huh? Well, since there's no stable hands around to help, I guess I can do it...
Paige begins to brush William's coat, looking around...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait a sec... You shouldn't be here. Monarch Prep made you leave when I transferred. You should be at that rent-a-stable Mom made you go to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why are you here at Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Because this is where I belong, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No way. You talk?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Of course I talk! It's `you` who doesn't always listen.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I talk! It's [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] who doesn't always listen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I listen! I'm listening right now, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Good. And now, `watch.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Good. And now, [color=#e23b3b][i]watch.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: William rears up and huge, feathered wings unfurl from his sides!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're a pegasus? OMG.
Paige staggers back and runs into someone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, watch it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, you could hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sam? What's going on? Why are you wearing that stupid elf hat? And why are you palling around with the dumb red-head from school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, because I'm not Sam. I'm Elf Sam. And this is Elf Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm an elf!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, ha ha, very funny. Come on, Sam. I've known you since your first day at Monarch Prep. You're not an elf.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're wrong.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know you've been `acting` like you don't know me since you sided with your cousin $ZOE over the whole Social Chair thing, but we used to be friends.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you've been [color=#3b78e2][i]acting[/i][/color] like you don't know me since you sided with your cousin $ZOE over the whole Social Chair thing, but we used to be friends.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who drove you to see Colt when he came back into your life? Who showed you how to stand up to Prissy? Do you even remember the Key Lime Pie Incident?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I remember all of those things! I just mean that I'm an elf, and I've always been an elf. That's why I never `really` fit in at Monarch Prep. I belong with other elves. You don't remember?
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I remember all of those things! I just mean that I'm an elf, and I've always been an elf. That's why I never [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] fit in at Monarch Prep. I belong with other elves. You don't remember?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um, I kind of think I'd remember a little thing like elf ears and a pointy hat.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Saaaam! Don't forget! We've got to hurry or we'll be late!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Late for what? What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're here to take you somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Open your mind, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you saying...

options.label: A horse is going to teach me some life lessons?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Really? I totally sided with David!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I mean, yeah. He had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he `was` out of the country...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, yeah. He had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] out of the country...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, `that` David and Jennifer... I thought you meant... Some other couple...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] David and Jennifer... I thought you meant... Some other couple...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Please, Paige. You know you're clueless about this.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Jennifer's a senior who just transferred in. David's obviously her ex-boyfriend who was always coming to visit.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Well, he had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he `was` out of the country...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, he had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] out of the country...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh, please. You don't even know who these people really are.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know they just broke up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh! And you probably didn't hear about the huge breakup that happened!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Jennifer and David broke up last month!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Jennifer and David? Who `are` these people?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jennifer and David? Who [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] these people?!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It was `very` messy.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] messy.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I totally sided with David. What do you think, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Um... I'm on...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, really, who would believe that you'd fail a test?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You really can't understand until you see him, Paige. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really, Pen. This is what happens when I'm not around?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Hey! Don't judge me! You've never even met him!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You really can't understand until you see him, Paige. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well. Fine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, I guess he must... Um... Be... Really hot!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Way to contribute. But honestly...

nodes.title: Paige's Nightmare After Christmas
nodes.subtitle: Can Paige escape her worst nightmare?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
It's the day after Christmas, and Paige's mother has sent her off with her Monarch Prep friends to a ski lodge up in the mountains.
The girls laze about the hotel lounge, ordering expensive food and drinks and gossiping next to a roaring fire.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige, it's `so` nice to have you back with us! I feel like we haven't seen you in forever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] nice to have you back with us! I feel like we haven't seen you in forever!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I've been busy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's nice to know that even if things at Twin Branches aren't always working out for me, I still have my loyal minions from Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It was really cool of your mom to let you come on the trip with us!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. It was the least she could do. Now that she's marrying Tad, the `last` thing she wants is me lurking around during their perfect holiday together.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please. It was the least she could do. Now that she's marrying Tad, the [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] thing she wants is me lurking around during their perfect holiday together.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh, don't tell me you're bitter about this? Tad's loaded. You're going to be set once your mom locks him down.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You could even come back to Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh? Oh... Right. Yeah, I guess that's true.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: OMG, that would be great!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah... The `best...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... The [color=#3b78e2][i]best...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I mean, you've just missed `so` much since you've been gone.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, you've just missed [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much since you've been gone.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, I'm sure I haven't missed that much. Good old Monarch Prep never really changes.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I wouldn't be too sure about that. Like, you haven't even seen the new chemistry teacher.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Squee! Professor Ting! He's `so` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Squee! Professor Ting! He's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I failed a test just so he'd talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. That's...

nodes.title: Howard's Holidays
nodes.subtitle: Sometimes coming home is the hardest part...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Howard.
The last time he was in town, he was skipping classes and completely neglecting his studies to see $ZOE, but now Howard's back in town for his `real` holiday break...
nodes.text_bbcode: The last time he was in town, he was skipping classes and completely neglecting his studies to see $ZOE, but now Howard's back in town for his [b]real[/b] holiday break...

nodes.text: It's Christmas Eve, and Howard and his family are decorating their Christmas tree.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard, it's so nice to have you home again! The family's finally back together!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Ee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad to be back. Baby Kara's getting so big...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And things have been so busy at Kingston... I really needed a break.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: We're all proud of you, son.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Howard's great.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Blah blah blah. Come on, this tree isn't decorating itself!
Howard reaches into a box of Christmas ornaments and pulls out a little glass duck wearing a Santa hat.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is an ornament that $ZOE gave me last year...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... Should we get rid of it?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I guess I can see why you gave it up!
The crowd cheers for Bryce!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Nice win, Bryce!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'm more rusty than I thought...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Hey, don't take it personally. It's just a game.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: There's a lot more to life than football.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now that's something I never thought I'd hear `you` say.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that's something I never thought I'd hear [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] say.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Heh. People change.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Okay, boys, enough games! It's almost time for the countdown!
Beth steps up, turns off the game system, and flips the tv channel to 'The Rockin' and Rollin' New Year's Eve Extravaganza!'
Howard is watching when suddenly a girl puts her hand on his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Howard?! That must be you! I'd recognize you anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that... Elliana? You haven't changed a bit! I haven't seen you since... Since...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Since we went to that dance together during your sophomore year? I know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you went back to Brazil!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hee hee, I did, for a while. But I got into another exchange program at Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: And then I moved here permanently to go to Centerscore U!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow. It's just... I can't believe you're here.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I know, right? You've grown up so much.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You make it sound like I was a kid when we went out together.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hee hee! Well, it `was` pretty obvious that I was the first girl you'd ever dated.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee! Well, it [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] pretty obvious that I was the first girl you'd ever dated.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I remember... I really thought...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: That we were meant to be? That you were in love?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that I'd never get over you!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: It's funny, isn't it? As much as we believe when we're younger that every heartbreak is forever... Time really does heal all wounds.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: And life goes on. You grow up, you fall in love again...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the past becomes the past. Yeah. It's kind of hard to remember that when you're in the middle of it, of course.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Of course! That's the charm of being young.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. I'm not sure I'll ever grow out of it.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Oh, that's right... I heard someone mention... You just had a bad break up, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. And I have to admit... It's hard to see it getting any better.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Well. Tonight is the night for leaving the past behind, isn't it?

nodes.text: Back in the day, we were an unstoppable team. Remember how it used to be?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Couldn't forget. Those were good times.
